moves.name: Jab / Forward Tilt
moves.notes: Steve can walk, jump, and double jump during this move.

moves.name: Up Tilt
moves.notes: Steve can walk, jump, and double jump during this move (but it is NOT the same as Up Air).

moves.name: Down Tilt
moves.notes: Flame has a general rehit rate of 6 frames. Flame is affected by Gravity and is absorbable and reflectable.

moves.name: Dash Attack
moves.onShield: Punch -15 | Wood -13 | Stone -12 | Iron -12 | Gold -10 | Diamond -10

moves.name: Forward Smash
moves.notes: Charge hold on frame 5
moves.onShield: Punch -22 | Wood -20 | Stone -19 | Iron -18 | Gold -15 | Diamond -17

moves.name: Up Smash
moves.notes: The final hit has a pickaxe sourspot. The sourspot isn't present if Steve has no pickaxe. The move doesn't use durability despite using a pickaxe.

moves.name: Down Smash
moves.notes: Lava is affected by gravity but not much because it has few active frames. Absorbable and reflectable.

moves.name: Neutral Air
moves.notes: Steve can walk, jump, and double jump during this move. Identical to Jab. No autocancel window.

moves.name: Forward Air
moves.notes: Frame 8 is a weak hit, frame 9 is a weak spike, frames 10-11 are a stronger spike. Autocancels on frame 1-2 and 20 onward (Gold autocancels 1-4 and 19 onward).
moves.shieldLag: Punch 10/11 | Wood 11/12 | Stone 12/13 | Iron 13/14 | Gold 11/12 | Diamond 14/15
moves.shieldStun: Punch 4/4 | Wood 5/5 | Stone 5/5 | Iron 5/5 | Gold 4/5 | Diamond 5/6
moves.onShield: Punch -8/-8 | Wood -8/-7 | Stone -7/-7 | Iron -7/-7 | Gold -8/-7 | Diamond -7/-6

moves.name: Sword Forward Air (Short Hop Macro FAir)
moves.notes: Only occurs out of a short hop macro. Shares frame data with jab but uses a sword instead of a pickaxe. No autocancel window.

moves.name: Back Air
moves.notes: Late hit is stronger. Autocancels on frame 1-4 and 22 onward (Gold autocancels 1-4 and 21 onward).
moves.shieldLag: Punch 11/11 | Wood 12/13 | Stone 13/14 | Iron 14/15 | Gold 12/13 | Diamond 15/16
moves.shieldStun: Punch 4/4 | Wood 5/5 | Stone 5/5 | Iron 5/6 | Gold 5/5 | Diamond 6/6
moves.onShield: Punch -8/-8 | Wood -7/-7 | Stone -7/-7 | Iron -7/-6 | Gold -7/-7 | Diamond -6/-6

moves.name: Sword Back Air (Short Hop Macro BAir)
moves.notes: Only occurs out of a short hop macro. Shares frame data with jab but uses a sword instead of a pickaxe. No autocancel window.

moves.name: Up Air
moves.notes: Gold is same startup but fewer total frames. Up Air is much faster overall than Up Tilt. This character is weird and makes no sense. Autocancels on frame 1 and 14 onward (Gold autocancels on frame 1 and 12 onward).
moves.onShield: Punch -4 | Wood -3 | Stone -3 | Iron -2 | Gold -1 | Diamond -1

moves.name: Down Air
moves.notes: Frame 25 is the earliest you can jump off (plus a 3 frame jumpsquat). If Steve lacks the materials, he has a 19 frame failure animation instead. Landing hit on frame 1 (whether or not Steve is still standing on it). Landing lag and advantage assumes Steve still is standing on it.

moves.name: Summon Crafting Table
moves.notes: Steve can use Crafting Table during shield and this ignores shield drop. Crafting Table's 7 frame startup is all that occurs, so he can effectively have a 7 frame shield drop by doing Crafting Table out of shield.

moves.name: Neutral B (Mine)
moves.notes: Durability of tools: 28(wood)/34(stone)/38(iron)/28(gold)/38(diamond). For a list of durability loss, check Meshima's Tweet. For even more information, check @robthemechon / @Chesometer's tweet for a full overview of mining!. It takes 56 frames to craft diamond, 45 for anything else.

moves.name: Side B (Minecart)
moves.notes: If Steve lacks the materials, he has a 15 frame failure animation instead. Damage depends on current speed. If traveling too slow, there's no hitbox. For Bailout, the jumping out animation is 5 frames before Steve can act. On frame 6 is when the cart can grab opponents. Armor notes: the minecart has 8.4HP and Steve himself has 60 knockback armor. The part of the armor that's hitpoint based can't drop to 0 during the first 17 frames.

moves.notes: Anvil active 15—22 but throws on frame 20. Without iron, the data is identical except for anvil's absense.
